text: Appeal of Order to Comply (December 8, 2021) for 35 Trudelle Street.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (December 8, 2021) for 35 Trudelle Street, Folder No. 21 235101 PRS 00 IV, and, in doing so, granted an extension of time to October 31, 2022.
